task_description: Build LDO-2 EDMS v3 - Engineering Document Intelligence Platform for Indian Railways. Full-stack Next.js 15 application with App Router, shadcn/ui design system (dense Vercel-style per design.md), tRPC API layer, Drizzle ORM schemas (ready for PostgreSQL), mock data layer, and all core modules: Dashboard, PL Knowledge Hub, Document Management, BOM Module, Work Ledger, OCR Pipeline, Search, Approvals, Cases, Admin. Uses Biome for linting, graphify for task tracking.
